title: Electric Daisy Carnival (EDC) UK Experience Trailer
description:
The world-famous dance music festival Electric Daisy Carnival (EDC) will return to the United Kingdom on the 12th of July for an epic one-day party that will see the Milton Keynes Bowl transformed into a magical world of jaw dropping production that has never been seen before in the UK, including the world's biggest 360° LED show. Expect an unrivalled visual experience to remember forever. 

Saturday -- July 12, 2014
Milton Keynes Bowl
 
Join the experience: https://www.facebook.com/ElectricDaisyCarnivalUK
Buy tickets: http://bit.ly/EDCUKTickets

Track reference is:
Song : Payback
Artist : Steve Angello, Dimitri Vangelis & Wyman
Label : Columbia Records
